offer.speaker: tatsumi
offer.text: Team Six, today's the day. The mission desk is on the ground floor of the Hokage residence.

offer.speaker: tatsumi
offer.text: Let's see what the Hokage has for us. And Ren: no, it won't be bandits.

steps.text: Go to the mission desk in the Hokage residence

dialogue.speaker: hiruzen
dialogue.text: Team Six. Your first mission as shinobi of the Leaf: a D-rank.

dialogue.speaker: iruka
dialogue.text: Ichiraku Ramen is short of firewood. Sixteen sticks of it, cut outside the village walls.

dialogue.speaker: ren
dialogue.text: Firewood?! I wanted to fight missing-nin!

dialogue.speaker: hiruzen
dialogue.text: Every shinobi starts here, Ren. Even the Fourth Hokage carried firewood.

steps.text: Gather firewood: 16 sticks (cut wood outside the walls)
Bring the firewood to Ichiraku Ramen

dialogue.speaker: teuchi
dialogue.text: Firewood! And split nice and even. Tell the old Hokage thanks.

dialogue.speaker: teuchi
dialogue.text: Here, a bowl on the house. A shinobi's first pay should come with ramen.
